text:
- chief complaint: annual exam.
- history of present illness: the patient has depression, hypertension, and a prior lobectomy. Depression is well controlled on Prozac with no recent incidents. Hypertension control is a struggle, with missed doses on weekends. Exertional symptoms occur during runs.
- physical examination: blood pressure 120/80, lower than prior readings. Slight 2/6 systolic ejection murmur. Lungs clear. No lower extremity edema. Sinus tenderness to palpation. EKG normal. Chest x-ray normal.
- symptoms experienced by the patient: shortness of breath with exertion in humid conditions, occasional chest pounding that resolves, nasal congestion from pollen.
- new medications prescribed or changed, including dosages: Prozac 20 mg daily refill ordered, no dose change. Norvasc continued, dose not specified.
- follow-up instructions: echocardiogram ordered for the murmur. Routine blood work ordered. Results will be sent through the patient portal. No further lobectomy workup or surgeon follow-up needed.
